Class WhoMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.autoconfigure.WhoMetrics
public final class WhoMetrics extends Object
Counts who's events as Micrometer meters: "who.sign-ins", "who.sign-outs", "who.sessions.ended", "who.credentials.added" and "who.credentials.revoked". Every tag value comes from one of who's enums; no address or id is ever a tag. Other events are ignored. A registry that fails is logged and never keeps the event from other listeners.
